description: Indian service-export GST refund guidance, record validation and Statement 3/Annexure B JSON generation without the GST offline Excel utilities.

notes: Guidance, requirements and validation are free without sign-in.
Direct JSON delivery uses OAuth with the refund:generate scope and access for the GSTIN/refund period.
Website sign-in and payment are available through a 24-hour browser handoff; ₹499 + GST covers both files and corrections.
